ActivityKind.description: What a registered unit of work is. The first five make a stop wait; the last three only keep an unattended core alive.

AggregateCategory.description: One category entry of an aggregate tool card header (`categories` / `doneCategories`).

AppSnapshotParams.description: `app/snapshot`: every unkeyed app section plus keyed sections bounded by configuration (SPEC R14). Replaces the whole section store.

ApprovalResolution.description: Durable outcome of a server request (P §8.4).

oneOf.description: First valid decision from any eligible connection.
The request's own `expiresAt` passed.
Own-turn interrupt or session close.
The asking run was cancelled from its parent.
The copy shown on a surface was taken away unanswered.
The session has no approval surface (`approvalMode: "implicit"`, headless exec): nobody was asked and nothing was persisted.

AttachmentOriginal.description: The picked file behind a resized image: its blob is kept while the record exists.

BlobDescriptor.description: Server-produced and embedded in store records, which parse it strictly.

BrowserWebrtcSignalParams.description: A phone's live-view signal (`browser/webrtcSignal` request, Node's `browserRemoteWebrtcSignal` call) and the core's signal to that phone (the `browser/webrtcSignal` push, Node's `browserRemoteWebrtc` event). `signal` is the validated wire object of `mixdog-remote::webrtc::signal` (`ClientSignal` / `DesktopSignal`).

CompactionStatus.description: How a compaction ended (the `status` of its divider row).

CoreDrainParams.description: Notification `core/drain` (`lifecycle-remote.md` §5.1 step 2): the core is draining; sent to every connected client with what is still running, and the token that authorizes an abort.

DrainRunning.description: One unit of running work, as listed to the user.

ErrorNotificationParams.description: `error`: a connection-scoped failure, or a thread error with `willRetry`.

FeedSnapshotParams.description: `feed/snapshot`: the read model of a scoped feed (terminal screen text, search result set, login flow state, port list).

HeldRequest.description: A held request of an unattended run (Node `meta.heldRequest`, `normalizeHeldRequest`). The desktop paints a pending one as an approval card and answers it with `id` through the ordinary approval call; `status` and `device` show how it settled.

payload.description: The outbound text the card may show; never a secret.

remember.description: The remember scopes the request allows.

HostBrowserViewFramesParams.description: A subscriber change → `on` with the largest options of the session's subscribers, last subscriber gone → `off` (SPEC §4.7.3; Node's `browserRemote('stream', [sessionId, options | null])`).

request.description: The largest `{maxWidth, maxHeight, fit?}` of the session's subscribers (Node's `largest`, `remote-browser-streams.ts`); `null` with `on: false`.

streamId.description: The X17 `streamId` the host stamps on this tab's frames.

ImageChip.description: Byte-free image metadata of a user row (`images`): its chip.

ImageChipId.description: `id` of an image chip: the paste number or a string id.

ImageRef.description: The stored original of one restored `[Image: …]` line (`imageRefs`); an image without a stored original has no `ref`, so later images keep their slot.

ImportedTool.description: One tool of an imported run: its name and how many times it ran.

ImportedToolRun.description: A run of tool use inside an imported assistant message's text. `start`/`end` locate the run's canonical line (`[ran tools: shell ×6, Read ×2]`) in `text` as UTF-16 code-unit offsets, Node's string indices; the client keeps a run only where the text still holds that line, and draws the text around the runs as assistant rows. The calls' results were never imported.

ItemMeta.description: Attributes shared by every item (today's `DesktopTranscriptItem` common fields).

ext.description: Remaining row attributes of today's transcript row.

messageId.description: The stable message id of the row's message (`meta.transcript.messageId`): what a compaction's dropped-message ids and a room line's `room.id` name.

posted.description: Delivered into the thread outside any turn (agent-home delivery).

JsonRpcErrorBody.description: `data` is always `{"reason": "<camelCase>", …typed fields}` (`ErrorData`); clients branch on `code` + `data.reason` only and never parse `message`.

MaybeBlob_for_AnyValue.description: A body that is inline when its encoding is ≤ `INLINE_MAX`, else a blob reference.

MaybeBlob_for_String.description: A body that is inline when its encoding is ≤ `INLINE_MAX`, else a blob reference.

MessageAttachment.description: One attachment of a user message (`meta.transcript.attachments`, `normalizeMessageAttachments`).

attachmentRef.description: The same hash again: the key the store's census marks as referenced.

id.description: The content hash (64 lowercase hex, no `sha256:` prefix) the attachment store keeps the bytes under.

MessageReaction.description: A bot's emoji reaction on a user message, one per bot, in the order left.

MessageSource.description: What a stored user-role message is (Node's `meta.source`). Absent on `UserRowDetails` means a typed prompt. Everything but a typed prompt, `Import`, `RoutineTrigger` and `Steering` is runtime-written text: a client shows it as the notice or card it stands for and never as the user's own words, and the core never sends such text as a plain prompt.

oneOf.description: Prose imported from another tool; plain text whatever it looks like.
A routine (schedule or webhook) fire; see `routineTrigger`.
A message delivered into the running turn.
A schedule's result posted into its owner's home thread.
A held request of an unattended run.
A delivered task or channel notification.

ModelProxyCancelParams.description: Server core → the connection running a `model/proxy/execute` request: the call was given up (cancelled, abandoned); stop spending on it. The connection's answer is no longer read.

ModelProxyRunEventParams.description: Local core → Electron: one streamed event of a `modelProxy/run` request.

ModelRequestUpdatedParams.description: `thread/modelRequest/updated`: one provider request of a turn (Node `model.request.*`). Request ids are `model_request_<index>`, the index counting from 1.

usage.description: Node's usage delta summary of the request, on `completed`.

leadUnit.description: A terminal relay frame whose cut fell inside a non-BMP character (Node's frames are cut in UTF-16 units): the lone low surrogate that comes before the bytes' text.

tailUnit.description: The lone high surrogate that comes after the bytes' text, for the same cut.

oneOf.description: A prompt was submitted: the client drops any held entry with the same whitespace-collapsed text, puts `prompt` in front and keeps the first 50.
Any other change (rewind, clear, abort): the whole list, newest first.

delivery.description: Delivery state of the failed attempt (SPEC §4.9).

ProxyEvent.description: One stream event of an attempt (`StreamEvent`).

oneOf.description: Semantic progress of the stream that has no delta event of its own (`StreamEvent::Progress`).
What one wire chunk reports for everything it carries; `null`: transport only (`StreamEvent::ChunkProgress`).
The assistant text the turn returns when it is not what the deltas folded to (`StreamEvent::FinalContent`).
The tool calls the turn returns when they are not the ones dispatched live (`StreamEvent::ReturnedCalls`).
Anthropic extended-thinking blocks, verbatim and ordered (`StreamEvent::ThinkingBlocks`).
A display-only transcript notice raised while preparing the request (`StreamEvent::Notice`).
The model that answered when it is not the one the request named (`StreamEvent::ServedModel`).
Provider facts the committed assistant turn keeps, Anthropic's fallback record (`StreamEvent::ProviderMetadata`).
The id the provider gave the response, which the usage ledger books the send under (`StreamEvent::ResponseId`).
The roster account that served the answer (`StreamEvent::AccountRouting`, Node `providerMetadata.accountRouting`).
The account pool moves on to the next account (`StreamEvent::AccountStage`, Node `onStageChange('reconnecting')`).
A fallback account became the selected one (`StreamEvent::AccountStage`, Node `onStageChange('account-changed')`).
The send went out once more on another wire after a refusal; the session's new `wireRoute`, whole (`StreamEvent::WireRerouted`, Node `wireReroute`).
The model began its output, which the usage ledger times the first-output wait from (`StreamEvent::OutputStarted`, Node `firstOutputAt`).
`pricing_model`: the catalog model the send bills as when it differs from the one sent. `request_ms`: the request's wall time as the usage ledger measured it (Node `usageDurationMs`).
The attempt failed and a retry begins: everything its events showed is dropped.
A retried attempt reported usage before it died; it is billed once, here.

reasoningTokens.description: Absent when the provider reported none; an explicit 0 stays 0.

QuestionAnswer.description: One `ask_user` answer, aligned by index with the questions.

RemotePointerParams.description: App-feed event: remote pointer position (today's `notify` remote pointer).

RoomLine.description: The payload of a group-room line (`normalizeRoomRow`, the row's `room`).

fromSession.description: A user line another session sent: its sender session, the sending bot and its name.

names.description: The members a collapsed run of failed passes names.

speaker.description: The member id of a speech or pass.

to.description: Addressee ids and their names, index for index.

RoomPart.description: A stored file reference of a room line (`parts`).

RoomTool.description: A tool a member used in its turn, as the speech line summarises it.

RoomUsage.description: The usage limit a `cap` line stopped at.

RoutineTrigger.description: The routine fire a turn delivered (`routineTrigger`): painted as its marker row.

SectionName.description: Every section name. The registry is closed: adding one is a contract change.

oneOf.description: `mixdog-config.json` subtrees (`desktop`, `notifications`, `toolPolicy`, `onboarding`, …); key = subtree.
Registered projects.
Agent pool rows.
Agent list (today's `listAgents`).
Bot order (today's `getBotOrder`).
Model presets (today's `listPresets`).
Model catalog (the `model/list` rows); when stubbed the client reads `model/list`, which is not paged.
Workflow list (today's `listWorkflows`).
Web-search route (today's `getWebSearchRoute`).

Tool-module settings, the value `getToolModuleSettings` answers today: `instructionFiles`, `autoEffortBase`, `webSearch`, `memory`, `git`, `office`, `tidy`, `visualize`, `media`, `localProvider` (with `installations`) and `autoEffort`. Pushed on change, replacing the desktop's status polls. Value: `ToolModuleSettings`.
Provider setup view (today's `getProviderSetup`, `listProviders`).
Provider accounts; key = provider id.
Usage summaries; key = scope.
Host-wide background shell totals.
Terminal activity per tab.
Terminal tab list.

Remote access: `{info, settings, claims, clients, controllerKeys, owedKeys, pairCode, pushRegistered}`; `pairCode` is a `RemotePairCode`, or `null` while no live code is held; `pushRegistered` lists the ids of the paired clients holding a native push registration.
In-app notices; key = notice id.
Update status (core updater and the desktop's `host/update/report`).
Desktop host state; key = `browserTabs` | `browserImport` | `visualize` | `displayPreferences` (desktop-published), or `remoteViewing` (core-published: the session ids paired devices show).
Computer use: `{active, observeOnly, controller, sessionThreadId}` (R40).
Pending approvals: count and per-thread summary.
Core state, including `draining{reason}` (R21).
Stall monitor report (`{stalledMs}`, R48).
Migration progress.
The tell that open reviews may read differently (Node's global `turn-review-changed`): one app-wide revision per tell, no value; each window rereads the review of every session it shows.
Repository status; key = repo root (scoped feed `git:<root>`).

Language-server status (scoped feed `lsp:<root>`); key = `<languageId>`, or `<languageId>\0<relPath>` for a status the server answered for one file (Node's `statusKey` in `editor-language-store.ts`). The value is Node's `DesktopLspStatusEvent`.
Diagnostics (scoped feed `lsp:<root>`); key = document uri. The value is Node's `DesktopLspDiagnosticEvent`; an empty `diagnostics` list clears the document.
Media job state; key = job id (scoped feed `media:<jobId>`).
Listening ports (scoped feed `ports`).

SectionStub.description: Value above `INLINE_MAX` is replaced by a stub; the client pages the detail with the section's list method.

SectionUpdate.description: Params of every section notification: `{"section", "key", "revision", "value"}` or `{…, "removed": true}` or `{…, "stub": {count, stub:true}}`. Exactly one of `value`, `removed`, `stub`. The client keeps `(section,key)` iff `revision` is greater than the stored one.

ServerRequestResolvedParams.description: To every eligible connection, losers included (P §8.4 step 4).

SetupUiRequest.description: The setup tool's desktop request waiting for a window to claim it (Node's session store `setupUiRequest`): its id, and when the thread took it.

oneOf.description: Durability waits under slow storage (R12).
Outcome of a barrier unknown; the thread is read-only.

ThreadActiveFlag.description: Active-state flags of a loaded thread (Codex flags plus Mixdog's).

ThreadFrameParams.description: One publication of the session's state as Node's frame publisher made it (`frame-batched-store.mjs`): the changes since the previous `thread/frame` are one state, and `structureRevision` goes up by one when they changed the rows' structure. Only a reader that shows Node's frames (the phone) reads it; the other notifications are unchanged.

fromItemId.description: Items after this one are discarded; absent for `clear`.

hasOlder.description: `hasOlder` of the thread's transcript after the reset: the only change of that flag outside a snapshot.

checkpointId.description: The turn's change-record key (what review reads and reverts address).

clientSubmissionId.description: The client correlation id of the submit.

countsForPromptHistory.description: Whether the prompt belongs in the composer's prompt history. Computed at commit (migration: for 1.4.5 history).

details.description: Sender, attachments, reactions and the other facts of the row.

displayText.description: The row text Node shows, chips included; the client's `user` row `text`. Computed at commit (migration: for 1.4.5 history).

importedToolRuns.description: Tool use an imported assistant message recorded (Node `importedToolRuns`); the client draws each as tool cards. Empty for every other message.

status.description: How it ended; the divider's label (`Conversation compacted`, `Compact failed`, …) and stats are `meta.label` and `meta.detail`.

oneOf.description: Every other built-in tool.

run.description: The tool row's shared facts (call id, display args/result, timing, aggregate).

oneOf.description: The end of a turn (Node's `turndone` row). `cancelled` is the interrupted end: the cancel line Node renders, with `elapsedMs` 0 when restored from the cancel text.

detail.description: A `failed` end's reason, details, error kind and quota stop.

finalAssistantId.description: The turn's last assistant row, on a `done` end.

oneOf.description: `statusdone` rows and notices.

A group-room line. A client builds Node's row from it: a `user` line is a `user` row, every other kind a `notice` row (tone `info`) whose `room` payload is `room` plus `id` = `meta.messageId` and `at`. `text` is the line's own words (user and speech lines; empty otherwise). Files and reactions sit on the line as on a user message.
A sub-agent dispatch row.

ThreadNotificationParams.description: `thread/notification`: a runtime notification (a finished background task, a channel message) as Node's `runtime.onNotification` delivers it. The delivered text also lands as a `task-notification` user row; this is the live event with its status.

meta.description: Node's `meta`; `meta.status` is `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `canceled` or `timed_out` when the notification settles a task.

ThreadRoomView.description: A group room's log as its views see it while the room runs (Node `agent-room-views.ts` `decorateRoomSnapshot`, pushed with the room's session state): the client lays it over the room log thread's own fields. Absent when the room has no exchange state and no handed-off questions.

busy.description: The room has an exchange state: the log reads busy (so the composer offers stop).

handoffQuestions.description: The questions of sessions the members handed work to, while they wait.

toolApproval.description: The speaking member's pending approval, as Node's queue presents it (`toolApproval`).

typing.description: The typing row naming who speaks (`{ kind: 'notice', id, tone: 'info', text, room: { kind: 'typing', speaker, name } }`), shown after the transcript.

sessionProvider.description: Always sent, `null` before the conversation has a provider (context-state.mjs `routeState`: `runtime.sessionProvider ?? null`).

waitingOnProviderSince.description: Provider keepalives seen while no content arrives (SPEC §4.9), epoch ms.

ThreadSectionParams_for_AnyValue.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_Boolean.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_Nullable_AnyValu.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_Nullable_PromptR.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_Nullable_Provide.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_Nullable_QuotaRe.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_Nullable_SetupUi.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_Nullable_ThreadR.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_PromptHistoryCha.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_ThreadAgents.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_ThreadApprovals.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_ThreadContext.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_ThreadRoute.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_ThreadRuntime.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadSectionParams_for_ThreadWorkflow.description: Params of the `thread/<section>/updated` notifications: one typed section of the projection.

ThreadStageUpdatedParams.description: `thread/stage/updated`: a run stage a client shows as its status, not a transcript row (Node's `onStageChange` relayed to the turn's `applyStageChange`: the spinner's mode and verb), with the stage's detail.

ThreadState.description: The runtime projection of one thread (today's `DesktopSessionState` fields, grouped as the thread-feed notifications of P §5.1 carry them).

promptHistoryList.description: The composer's Up-arrow recall (today's `promptHistoryList`, Node's merged list): the thread's user prompts over the whole transcript plus the per-folder saved prompt history of its cwd, newest first, trimmed, at most `PROMPT_HISTORY_LIMIT` (50), one entry per whitespace-collapsed text.

roomView.description: A group room log's view while the room runs (`thread/roomView/updated`).

setupUiRequest.description: The setup tool's desktop request, from the notice until it is claimed or its claim window ends.

ThreadSummary.description: One list row (today's `DesktopSessionSummary`), live on the app feed as `thread/summary/updated`.

ToolAggregate.description: What an aggregate tool card (`aggregate: true`, name `__aggregate__`) adds.

callIds.description: The calls the card folds, in order.

ToolApprovalDecision.description: Mixdog's `ToolApprovalDecision` without `device`: the core stamps the device from the answering connection (P §8.1). The result type of every approval server request.

answers.description: `ask_user` answers aligned with the questions; `null` = unanswered.

editedArgs.description: edit-and-approve: the edited text of the request's editable fields.

reply.description: `ask_user`: the composer message that answered the question.

response.description: Human-in-the-loop response; a secret value never travels here (`approval/provideSecret`).

scope.description: Permission requests: the chosen scope id.

ToolApprovalResult.description: How the last approval of a thread ended (today's `toolApprovalResult`).

ToolBatchUpdatedParams.description: `thread/toolBatch/updated`: the tool calls of one model response run together (Node `tool.batch.*`). Batch ids are `tool_batch_<request index>`.

calls.description: On `completed`: the calls the batch ran.

ToolMeta.description: A result's side channel: a stable code, the missing capability names and, for a `visualize` call run for another session's work, that owner session.

ToolRun.description: The facts of a tool row shared by every tool-backed item variant (today's `kind: 'tool'` row). `args`, `result` and `rawResult` are the row's display values; the variant's own fields stay the typed call.

callId.description: The call id tying the row to its call and result messages.

live.description: Built by a live turn's tool cards (`turn-tool-cards.mjs`): the row reads as that turn's card, an `__aggregate__` even for one call, not as the card a restore rebuilds (`mergeRestoredToolItems` merges only two or more).

toolMeta.description: The structured side channel of a result (`toolMeta`).

items.description: Present only when the read asked for items (`itemsView`).

stopReason.description: The model's stop reason of the turn's final answer (Node `result.stopReason`, a provider string such as `end_turn`); on a completed turn only.

terminationReason.description: Why the turn ended where it did (Node `result.terminationReason`; `refusal` is the one the headless result treats as an error); on a completed turn only.

oneOf.description: The turn was interrupted by the user.

TurnError.description: Why a turn failed: an error reason object (`{reason, …}`, P §10) and, for provider failures, the typed upstream detail.

data.description: `{reason, …typed fields}` exactly as in JSON-RPC error `data` (P §10).

UiOpenRequestedParams.description: App-feed event (`desktop-services.md` §12.4): the core asks attached UIs to open something. One variant per Node flow it replaces: `browser-open-requested`, `terminal-run-requested` and the visualize open (`visualize/open-actions.ts`).

oneOf.description: `DesktopBrowserOpenRequest` (`shared/contract-browser.ts`).

error.description: An agent's `open` that failed, and why: nothing is revealed for it.

handoff.description: A takeover hand-off: the user must act on the page, so the panel opens even where closed.

hide.description: Hide only: never create or release pages; overrides `reveal`.

reveal.description: `false` creates or retains the surface without opening the session dock.

tabId.description: An agent's `open`: the page it showed (session-local id `p…`).

oneOf.description: `DesktopTerminalRunRequest` (`shared/terminal-command.ts`): the `terminal` tool ran a command in one of the session's terminals.

requestId.description: The core waits on this: the desktop renderer claims it once a pane really shows `terminalId`; unclaimed, the run is reported as running in the background. Not sent to paired clients.

tabs.description: Every terminal the core runs for the session: tabs the device lacks are added.

terminalId.description: The terminal the command went to; its tab is selected. (The spec's §6.3 sketch calls it `tabId`; Node's request, which this follows, calls it `terminalId`.)

oneOf.description: The visualize open: a web URL handed to the session's browser panel (`openUrl`), or a revealed tab (`reveal`, `tab`), as `DesktopVisualizeEvent` carries them.

openRequestId.description: With `openUrl`: names the request, so the browser tab the pane creates reports back to the agent's open (`ui/newTab/created`) and no other tab does.

tab.description: An agent open or content update: bring the panel up on this tab.

UiProviderModelsChangedParams.description: `ui/providerModels/changed` (app feed) and `ui/providerModels/announce`: Node's `provider-models-changed` desktop event `{origin}` (ipc-state-bridge.ts:113, remote-relay-push-lanes.ts:53).

UiSettingsChangedParams.description: `ui/settings/changed` (app feed) and `ui/settings/announce`: Node's `settings-changed` desktop event, which reached the windows and every paired device (ipc-state-bridge.ts:114, remote-relay-push-lanes.ts:54).

tab.description: Tab number within the session (1 = the session's first terminal).

UserInput.description: One input element of a user message.

oneOf.description: An image or file attachment, by content digest.
Pasted text kept out of line (today's `pastedTexts`).

UserRowDetails.description: Who and what a user row came from, beyond its content.

botChain.description: The bots that handed the message on, sender last.

consumedExecutionIds.description: The executions a woken batch delivered; `null` keeps the position of an entry that named none.

fromAgent.description: The bot that sent the message (a bot's `session send`).

heldRequest.description: The request of a `held-request` message; the client's row carries it as `heldRequest`.

roomRow.description: A group-room member turn: the newest user row of the room log its prompt shows.

sender.description: The sender (`lead` for the user's Lead session).

source.description: What the message is; absent for a typed prompt.

steered.description: Delivered into the running turn (steering): the row's read mark.

submissionIds.description: Every submission a merged queued batch delivered as this turn.

oneOf.description: Atomic snapshot at the feed seq it is stamped with.
The authoritative, persisted row.
Section `roomView`: a group room log's view while the room runs (`decorateRoomSnapshot`).
The core's live-view signal to one phone (offer, candidate, promote, demote, close, geometry).
A JPEG-view frame of a browser session the phone streams (Node's `browserRemoteFrame` push): one in flight until `browser/streamAck`.
Node's `settings-changed` event: settings pages re-read (a writer's announcement, a notification store write, or a change of the config outside `desktop`).
Node's `provider-models-changed` event: every client drops its provider model lists; `origin` names the announcer.
Draining: what still runs and the token that authorizes an abort (`lifecycle-remote.md` §5.1).
Sections `providerSetup` and `providerAccounts`.
Section `reviewDiff`: the app-wide tell that open reviews may read differently (Node's `turn-review-changed`).
Snapshot of any scoped feed (its read model).
